issues.description: Q2: ③ 'them' → 'those'. 'them are customers who...'는 명백한 비문. 영어에서 them은 목적격이므로 주어 자리에 사용 불가. those who = 표준 관계사절 선행사. 정답 논란 없음.
Q16 wa='the costs to switch to another product' — stem says (7단어). Count: the(1) costs(2) to(3) switch(4) to(5) another(6) product(7) = 7단어. 검증 통과.
Q17 wa='is often perceived as a sign of quality' — stem says (8단어). Count: is(1) often(2) perceived(3) as(4) a(5) sign(6) of(7) quality(8) = 8단어. 검증 통과.

issues.category: 서술형 — wa 단어수 + S-WA-IN-PASSAGE 예외 검증
issues.description: Q18 wa='the same categories of customers, not sensitive to' — stem says (8단어). Count: the(1) same(2) categories(3) of(4) customers(5) not(6) sensitive(7) to(8) = 8단어(콤마 제외). S-WA-IN-PASSAGE: wa가 passage에 노출되나, 유형이 서술형—핵심단어(찾기 유형)이므로 예외 적용. 검증 통과.
Q19 wa='are less sensitive to price than' — stem says (6단어). Count: are(1) less(2) sensitive(3) to(4) price(5) than(6) = 6단어. [조건]: are/less/price/sensitive/than/to = 6토큰. 모든 조건 단어가 wa에 포함됨. 검증 통과.
Q20 wa='are ready to spend a lot for' — stem says (7단어). Count: are(1) ready(2) to(3) spend(4) a(5) lot(6) for(7) = 7단어. [조건]: a/are/for/lot/ready/spend/to = 7토큰. 모든 조건 단어가 wa에 포함됨. 검증 통과.
